grh_e8a0cc1d83068230dea5.title: The Man Who Changed His Mind
paragraphs: Grocer Alex Johnson becomes furious when Dr. Christian quarantines his household after young Dickie contracts scarlet fever. Because Johnson runs a food store, the quarantine means he cannot simply live at home and continue working, and he declares that once the danger is past Christian will no longer be the family doctor. Weeks later the Johnson children play doctor in their backyard playhouse. They take real medicines from the house and give several pills and liquids to Dottie, then lock the playhouse as part of their game. When Christian learns what happened he breaks down the door, rushes the poisoned child to treatment and uses every antidote and stimulant he can while the family is being located. Johnson arrives still angry, believing Christian has interfered with his children yet again, only to discover the doctor is fighting to save his daughter. Dottie finally regains consciousness and passes the crisis. Faced with Christian's persistence and care despite having been dismissed, Johnson admits he was wrong, asks forgiveness and offers him a lifetime appointment as the Johnson family physician.
